Whether it was building elaborate LEGO sets with my family or forging new connections with friends, I found joy in creating and sharing. My love for baking began in my childhood, baking Christmas cookies with my maw maw and nana and making weekly treats with my mom. I didn't realize it at the time, but I was falling in love with the way food, especially my nana’s poundcake, brought our family together. Every year, whether it was a holiday or a family reunion, people lined up just to get a slice of her cakes. I saw how food could create joy and connection, and that realization sparked a deeper passion in me. When I was 11, I attempted to make cheesecake for family and friends. Though I failed miserably, that failure ignited a drive within me. Today, at 22, I’m proud to run Burton’s Bakery, where I can share my passion and bring smiles to customers' faces, one slice and one cake at a time! Whether through photos on Instagram, TikTok videos, or face-to-face interactions, sharing this journey and making people happy has always been my dream. My ultimate goal is to expand Burton’s Bakery into its own space and grow the franchise even further. Thank you for being a part of my journey.
